meta.notes: Manages how a moment appears until a plain objection arrives. A real privacy claim on negatives later stolen. Privacy never reads as guilt. She is right about the window.

threads.source: World and comedy. Pick one bank line per scene.

threads.topic: You sat for her, at the Arcade.
threads.source: S06, B06. Adela concedes the window and keeps the negatives. The player is hearing the complaint against herself and may only ask.

rs_s1.line: Thirty writers, six orchestras, and a new electric transmitter. And tonight the hero meets the same villain he met last Thursday. I'd complain, but I am the villain's wife, and I've got the good scarf.

choices.label: I heard a sheet of tin.

rs_s2.line: That was thunder! Fifteen years of stagecraft, and she laughs harder when the effects man rattles a sheet of tin. My own mother. I could hear her from the studio, I swear to you, in Queens.

rs_p1.line: "Sat." I asked for a portrait, not an engagement. She got me between one face and the next, and put that in a window on Jackson Avenue. My name on the card. I've spent twenty years deciding what's seen of me, and a woman with a rubber bulb takes it in a fiftieth of a second.

choices.label: What did you ask her for?

rs_p1s.line: You're doing that very well. Most people fill that gap with their opinion of my eyes.

rs_p2.line: Of course it's a good picture! That's what's wrong with it! And you said that exactly how she did.

choices.label: What did you ask her for?

rs_p2s.line: Now you've gone red. Why have you gone red?

rs_p3.line: Destroy them. She took it down. She said it wouldn't go in that window or anyone else's, and she kept the plates anyway, and she told me it was the most reasonable she got. I went round on the twenty-second to ask again. Do you know, somebody'd saved me the trouble?

rs_p4.line: At home, with the booth shut. I recorded a take for my own files at ten, which I shall not be playing you. Ask me who heard it. Nobody. That's what the booth is for. You may keep your suspicion. You may not keep putting me in the window.
